<@&1424461167883194418> Model updates — 2026-09-30

### 🆕 New
- 🧠 **Claude Sonnet 5.5** (Anthropic) — image input, reasoning and tools
- 🧠 **GPT-5.3 Codex** (OpenAI) — coding-focused reasoning and tools
- 🧠 **MiMo V2.6 Flash / Pro** (Xiaomi) — image input and reasoning
- 🧠 **Ling 3.0 Flash VL** (inclusionAI) — image/video input and tools
- 🎨 **MAI Image 2.6 / Flash** (Microsoft) — generation and reference editing
- 🎨 **FLUX 1.1 Pro** (Black Forest Labs) — text-to-image
- 🎬 **MiniMax H3 Max** (MiniMax) — video with synchronized audio
- 🔊 **OpenAI TTS / TTS HD** (OpenAI) — text-to-speech
- 🔊 **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (Google) — speech-to-text
- 🔊 **ElevenLabs Stem Separation** (ElevenLabs) — two or six tracks
- Also added: 22 community text routes, three image models and three audio models.

### 🗑️ Removed
- `perplexity/sonar-pro` · `perplexity/sonar-reasoning-pro` (text)
- `amazon/nova-canvas-v1` (image) · `amazon/nova-reel-v1` (video)
- Additional community routes were removed; see the model catalog.

### ⬇️ Price cuts (~25% off)
- 🎨 Image: GPT Image 2.5 Flare · Sunburst
- 🧠 Text: community GLM 5.3 Flash · supercharge · MetraxAI

### ⬆️ Price increases
- 🎬 Video: MiniMax H3 Max Turbo (+300%)
- 🧠 Text: GPT-6 Astra (+35%) · DeepSeek V4 Flash (+50%) · MiniMax M2.7 (+10%) · several community routes
- 🎨 Image: community Uncensored v2 (+10%)

### 🔒 Going paid-only
- DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Exp · Muse Glimmer 30B · Kimi K2.7 Code · DeepSeek V4 Pro · GLM-5.2 · Perplexity Sonar · three community routes

### 🔓 Now free
- GPT-6 Luna · GPT-6 Sol

### ✨ Capability updates
- `qwen/qwen3.8-2.4t-a95b` · `pollinations/midijourney` · `pollinations/midijourney-large` · `community/voodoohop/airforce-grok-4-fast` — added image input
